objective: Reduce native viewport-measurement churn on fast Community Wall/Marites scrolling and avoid overlapping Marites/Wall active video decoders without altering existing video engine, audio, or ads.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main a43e1813d62a151e8294a52989a80fe21b36057c inspected 2026-11-13. Production deployed fingerprint/active client not independently verified. Existing Android OOM scope records Infinix X6852 Android 16 historical OOMs, up to four video decoders and unresolved allocation attribution. This is a scoped source-only mitigation; NOT verified live crash resolution.
chosenApproach: 96ms trailing-coalesced Marites measureInWindow scheduling with immediate flush on focus/overlay and cleanup on unmount. Disable inline Marites video only while an active Wall video, fullscreen viewer, open comments, or Wall blur has priority. Preserve single-visible Marites selection and existing expo-video/IMA implementations. Add bidirectional fullscreen Marites media priority: parent Wall inline player/music pauses on story open; Marites viewer audio remains allowed; exit/expiry/unmount restores Wall eligibility.
selectionRationale: Existing Wall scroll callback fires every 16ms and requests a potentially native bridge measurement; reducing measured work avoids UI churn. Marites header and Wall video can overlap; deterministic priority prevents two simultaneous autoplay players in this path. Both are minimal, reversible UI-only changes.
alternativeApproaches: Replace FlashList or expo-video renderer globally, rejected due to broad high-risk media regressions and native rebuild requirements.
Disable all video autoplay, rejected because visible Wall/Marites playback is an approved functional feature.
Throttle Marites measurements only while keeping immediate focus handling and give Wall active video priority, selected.
preserveBehaviors: Existing active CommunityVideo/IMA player, buffering, poster, sound, retry, PTT coexistence and preloading policies remain unchanged.
Marites only autoplays while the card is actually visible and Wall video is not active; story viewer retains direct video playback.
AdMob native/banner lifecycle, placements, consent, impressions and safety locks remain unchanged.
FlashList virtualization, scroll position, pagination, caption/music creation, notification routing and signed media URLs remain untouched.
No changes to Supabase, RLS, permissions, security, billing or production release tooling.

Fullscreen Marites story audio may play when a Wall inline video's visibility token remains stale; opening the viewer pauses the Wall player, closing restores it. Preserve current video engine, cache and AdMob.
acceptanceChecks: 60 Wall scroll frames result in around 10 Marites native measurements or fewer, first paint visible immediately.
Focus blur, comment modal or fullscreen activation immediately disables inline playback; pending timers cannot resurrect stale media.
When active Wall video exists, inline Marites decoder is unmounted; when it stops, eligible Marites autoplay resumes.
Old Marites visibility selector, no offscreen playback, 750ms header fallback, active expo-video and AdMob surfaces preserved.
Focused tests and mandatory PR gates pass; compiled RC and physical staging-user Android run still mandatory before any OTA.

Fullscreen Marites story owns playback over a visible Wall clip, including sound and viewer-to-viewer navigation; back/expiry/unmount restores Wall eligibility and audio does not auto-restart under the modal.
